title: WikiLambda the Ultimate
summary: This is a Wikipedia Signpost article covering recent research about WikiLambda, a Wikimedia project that aims to create a collaborative repository of reusable computational functions accessible across Wikimedia projects. The article discusses advances in this function wiki ecosystem.
problem_solved: WikiLambda addresses the lack of reusable, computable functions within the Wikipedia ecosystem by creating a shared library that can be called from any Wikimedia project.
why_valuable: It enables interoperability and computation capabilities across Wikipedia, allowing editors to create and share functional operations without needing programming expertise.
